description: carbonintensity-api is a Rust library and command-line client for the UK National Grid Carbon Intensity API. Its README documents current and date-bounded queries at national, numbered region or postcode level and points to the provider's API terms. Users select a UK region and time interval; outputs are electricity carbon-intensity values at the API's temporal resolution. Geographic coverage is the United Kingdom as divided by the provider. GitHub metadata states Apache-2.0 licensing for the client; the API has separate use conditions. A limitation is that grid-average intensity is not the marginal emissions effect of one new load or asset, and not all provider endpoints are exposed by the client. It can prepare operational emissions context for electricity-demand and building-energy simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model can use carbon assumptions, but no direct interface was tested. No API response or Rust package was downloaded.
